mentions.author: undershirt
mentions.why: Recited version of the poem Ozymandias
mentions.quote: There are two versions of the poem “Ozymandias”[1][2]. They tell the exact same story but in two completely different ways. After reading both, I’m almost certain you will find one more effective than the other. So I hope you reconsider that some ideas are not simply reducible…
